postgres_cmd exports the actual container POSTGRES_PASSWORD for psql/pg_isready, preserving argv and stdin and ignoring unrelated host PGPASSWORD.
compose_cmd and Nginx mutation return explicitly on failed fence, including set +e and Bash conditional contexts.
Preserve the four existing pure-audio regression scenarios and sources/meters test harness while removing only integration behavior.
